children: Wizz Air's financial targets for 2030 are ambitious but credible, J.P. Morgan equity research director Harry Gowers writes. The Hungarian airline released a statement ahead of its investor day, aiming for 10 billion euros in revenue and a 10% EBIT margin, both of which are higher than the Bloomberg consensus, he says. "These targets look ambitious versus Wizz's profitability postpandemic, but we also view them as achievable if the company can execute within a broadly stable environment," Gowers says. JPM has a neutral rating on the stock and 12.00-pound price target. Shares are up 3.8% to 988.50 pence, though they are down 22% year to date. (joseph.wilkins@wsj.com)
